title: Clinical Synthetic Data Generation Framework
summary: A benchmarking suite for evaluating and comparing eight synthetic tabular data generation methods (including CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE, CTAB-GAN, GANerAid, PATE-GAN and MEDGAN) across several clinical/healthcare datasets such as breast cancer, Alzheimer's and liver disease. The notebooks import CTGAN with a fallback chain through sdv.single_table.CTGANSynthesizer and sdv.tabular.CTGAN, and rely on the sdv/ctgan/copulas/rdt/sdmetrics stack pinned in requirements.txt, so SDV's tabular synthesizers (CTGAN, CopulaGAN, TVAE) are run as several of the eight generative models being compared.
